exposure: early colonization with the Staphylococcaceae family (Firmicutes phylum)
cohort: 122 infants from the Growing Up in Singapore Towards Healthy Outcomes (GUSTO) birth cohort
finding: Infants with rhinitis, particularly those with concomitant wheeze, exhibited distinct nasal microbiota development patterns compared to healthy controls, characterized by decreased bacterial diversity and increased abundance of certain bacterial families.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a determinant of nasal microbiota succession.
